scope: The same 79 available Ruby-set artifacts from the completed bad-pool triage; relocated benign bytes were read from /tmp/triage/misplaced-good.

analysis.facts: cleave facts inspected six changed behavior sources, including the extracted Rack session-store member. All sample analysis and query checks were static.
analysis.snapshots: Complete before/final atomscan reports are in /tmp/ruby-improve. The finished snapshot includes all final rule and namespace changes.

changes.subject: Cookie execution
changes.result: Bind HTTP_COOKIE access to Base64 decoding and that exact value to eval, including inline eval. Keep production-mode checks neutral and name the combined observation without claiming the check dominates every evaluator.
changes.controls: Unrelated eval values, display-only code, different headers, quoted code, comment-only Rails checks and ordinary local templates.

changes.subject: Credential collection
changes.result: Require a home-relative loop over SSH/cloud/service credential targets, the same File.read/binread path and the same encoded contents. Relocate the collector from credential-manager identity to file secret-sweep; keep read/encoding mechanics neutral.
changes.controls: Different read path, different encoded value, and ordinary file encoding with unrelated credential-path comments.

changes.subject: Sensitive-file inventory
changes.result: Replace path-only glob/read claims with actual glob-to-read-to-SHA256 value binding. Hash inventory remains suspicious without inventing an export.
changes.controls: Different file read or different value hashed.

changes.subject: HTTP script runner
changes.result: Require the received body to reach the named executor parameter, a temporary-file write, that file path in the command, and the same command reaching Open3. Describe separate TLS-bypass evidence as co-occurrence.
changes.controls: Different body, helper, temporary path or executed command; renamed and reordered helpers remain detected.

changes.subject: CI preload activation
changes.result: Observe the same GITHUB_ENV destination passed to append-mode File.open and a RUBYOPT=-r value written to that handle. Combine it with a credential collector for hostile CI preload activity.
changes.controls: Other destination, overwrite mode, unrelated setting, and ordinary profiler preload without credential collection.

changes.subject: HTTP JSON sender
changes.result: Place generic POST-body bindings in request/json and request/body/construction, rather than credential-body-flow. Accept JSON.generate/dump, protected request calls and the request(req, payload.to_json) form. Beacon/exfil reference convictions now require an actual constructed JSON POST sender.
changes.controls: Route constants without a sender, unsent requests and renamed client variables.

changes.subject: Unsupported platform/intent claims
changes.result: Move generic VM-vendor names, package-list commands, repository/CI paths and health-log paths into neutral capability homes. Detect actual Ruby process-title assignment independently of a chosen service-looking name. Remove an unsupported RubyGems/exfil conviction based only on those references.
changes.controls: Reference-only strings, renamed real process titles and quoted title assignments.

changes.subject: Duplicate generic warnings
changes.result: Retire unused Base64/eval proximity under extconf; existing neutral decoding/eval context remains. Retire generic Ruby/Fiddle loading as a GTFOBins identity; its library-loading capabilities remain.
